features.name: Reproducible dsh plugin set
features.description: Declare third-party dsh plugins in plugins.json, apply them from install.sh via scripts/install-plugins.sh, and pin versions so a second machine installs the same. The set is dsh-mermaid for the web profile; dsh-diagram cannot run on the pinned dsh (see evidence).
features.evidence: plugins.json + scripts/install-plugins.sh (2026-09-11): installed dsh-mermaid@0.4.0 and dsh-diagram@0.4.0 into the web profile (exit 0, 2 added); dsh --profile web --dump-default-config shows # == dsh-mermaid and # == dsh-diagram; re-run reports 0 added / 2 already installed; init.sh guards fail on latest, a range, a duplicate, a missing field and a dropped install.sh call; ./init.sh exit 0; harness audit 100/100. Amended after the first UI restart (2026-09-11): dsh-diagram@0.4.0 killed the web boot (client injects `conversationEvents`, absent from dsh 0.1.5-rc.1; boot showed 'Failed to load plugins'), so it was removed from the profile and from plugins.json; with dsh-mermaid@0.4.0 alone the UI boots and a ```mermaid fence rendered as an SVG (3 nodes, 7 labels) with Diagram/Code toggle, fullscreen and Download SVG -> mermaid-flowchart.svg (13,379 B). Set is now 1 plugin over the web profile.

features.name: Pre-flight plugin compatibility
features.description: Refuse to install a plugin whose published manifest says it cannot run on the pinned dsh: check dsh.compatibility.dshReleases and resolve every dsh.client.inject id against the pinned install before anything touches a profile.
features.evidence: scripts/plugin-preflight.sh + wiring (2026-09-11): dsh-mermaid@0.4.0 -> exit 0; dsh-diagram@0.4.0 -> exit 1 naming compatibility [0.1.0-rc.6 0.1.0-rc.8 0.1.1-rc.1 0.1.1-rc.2] vs pinned 0.1.5-rc.1; same spec with --dsh-version 0.1.1-rc.2 -> exit 1 via check B alone (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime unresolved), so the two checks are independent; unpinned -> exit 2; git/unresolvable -> exit 1. End-to-end: with dsh-diagram temporarily back in plugins.json the applier exited 1 ('blocked by pre-flight') and left the profile untouched (dependencies still [dsh-mermaid], no node_modules/dsh-diagram); --skip-preflight is the override. init.sh fails when the call is removed or the script loses +x. ./init.sh exit 0; harness audit 100/100.

features.name: Check the Node major at install time
features.description: install.sh only asks whether node exists, so a Node 18 machine passes and fails later. Add scripts/check-node.sh: fail below the Node 20 floor, warn when the major diverges from .nvmrc, and call it from install.sh before anything is created.
features.evidence: scripts/check-node.sh + install.sh wiring (2026-09-11): real node 22.22.2 -> ok exit 0 (matches .nvmrc 22); fake node v18.20.0 first on PATH -> FAIL exit 1 naming the Node 20 floor and the pin; fake v24.1.0 -> warn exit 0; install.sh with the v18 fake and DSH_HOME=/tmp/checknode-dsh exited 1 and did not create DSH_HOME (step 0 precedes every write); init.sh fails when install.sh drops the call or the script loses +x; ./init.sh exit 0; harness audit 100/100.

features.name: Expand the plugin set with the vetted web bundle
features.description: Add four plugins to plugins.json after pre-flighting each against dsh 0.1.5-rc.1: dshmarket (the plugin market inside Settings), @liustack/modsearch (web search + page fetch, replacing the built-in web_search that has no key on this route), @anionex/dsh-vision-toolkit (vision bridge for the text-only routes) and dsh-find-plugin (agent-side plugin discovery). Candidates rejected by the pre-flight are recorded, not installed.
features.evidence: plugins.json + install run (2026-09-11): 8 candidates pre-flighted against dsh 0.1.5-rc.1 via ./scripts/plugin-preflight.sh — 5 ok (dshmarket@1.45.1, dsh-find-plugin@0.3.7, @liustack/modsearch@5.10.2, @anionex/dsh-vision-toolkit@0.1.44 which is the only one declaring dshReleases[0.1.5-rc.1]=compatible, and the existing dsh-mermaid@0.4.0), 3 blocked with exit 1 on unmet client inject @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime (dsh-vision-router@2.1.5, dsh-web-search-pro@0.1.11, dsh-free-search@0.4.24). ./scripts/install-plugins.sh -> '4 added, 1 already installed, 0 failed, 0 blocked by pre-flight' exit 0; re-run -> '0 added, 5 already installed'; dsh plugin --profile web list = 5 packages; dsh --profile web --dump-default-config prints a layer for each. ./init.sh exit 0 (9 features, 1 in-progress, 5 plugins pinned); harness audit 100/100; 129 knowledge/doc links checked, 0 broken. Not verified: the four client halves are not live until the web profile restarts. Restarted 2026-09-11 13:2x — the four bundles are live: the served page carries a registry entry (each with its own rev) and client.js returns 200 for dsh-mermaid, dshmarket, @liustack/modsearch and @anionex/dsh-vision-toolkit; headless Chromium renders the UI with 0 console errors and Settings shows the Plugin Market, Vision and Search engine (ModSearch) tabs. dsh-find-plugin is host-only: no client bundle by design, activation = the clean boot. Per-plugin runtime state measured with each plugin's own tooling (2026-09-11): modsearch doctor -> fetch/read_page READY keyless via the local engine (verified on example.com), search/web_search resolves to firecrawl whose keyless route answers 403 for this IP so it needs TAVILY_API_KEY / EXA_API_KEY / firecrawl.apiKey or the agy CLI, x_search needs grok-cli; dsh-vision-toolkit needs nothing -- its free defaults authenticate (GET /v1/models 200 with the literal key) and a real image turn described a screenshot correctly in ~7s. Correction: an earlier note in this session claimed web_search was verified keyless through modsearch; that call was the omp harness tool, not the plugin.
